title: Improved Drops
description:
Hi there! This mod for minecraft forge 1.20.1 adds some features that the game NEED:
Thirsty system(not affects to health, only to saturation)
New Deco blocks, like golden bars and chiseled gold
New Crop - Pepper and nether pepper (soon)
body:
# **Hi there!** 

![LOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6808d5d1e368b9fdf7ec6ca8dc0e2b56581fc0f.png)

We are SovietMine Studios. This mod for minecraft forge 1.20.1 and neoforge 1.21.1 adds some features that the game NEED: new mobs, cool weapons for immersive combat, blocks, interesting mechanics etc. And yeah, this mod using drop update system: not big, but cool updates (but there were HUGE updates, divided into some drops).

## What is already added
.New thirst system (affects to saturation of food)

.Different eating speed for different types food

.Decorative golden blocks, like golden bars or chiseled gold

## In testing

.Cool weapons: flint crossbow, echo blade.

  .New frost oak (BIOME SOON)

## DUNGEON UPDATE: Drop one SOON!
![NEW UPDATE LOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/439b6eac6303040a02e9ae16422ec1bbe9a91056.png)
